using LinearAlgebra

const NUM_SEQ_NUM_RES_MSA_FEATURES = []
const NUM_SEQ_MSA_FEATURES = []
const MSA_PAD_VALUES = Dict{String,Any}()

function _pad_features_to_max(feat_name::String, chains::Vector{Dict{String,Array}}, axis::Int)
    max_num_seq = maximum([size(chain[feat_name], axis) for chain in chains])
    padded_feats = []
    for chain in chains
        feat = chain[feat_name]
        padding = zeros(Int, ndims(feat))
        padding[axis] = max_num_seq - size(feat, axis)
        padding_tuple = [(0, p) for p in padding]
        padded_feat = similar(feat, size(feat) .+ [p[2] for p in padding_tuple])
        padded_feat .= get(MSA_PAD_VALUES, feat_name, 0)
        idx_src = [1:size(feat, i) for i in 1:ndims(feat)]
        idx_dst = [1:size(feat, i) for i in 1:ndims(feat)]
        padded_feat[idx_dst...] = feat[idx_src...]
        push!(padded_feats, padded_feat)
    end
    return padded_feats
end

function merge_msa_features(feat_name::String, chains::Vector{Dict{String,Array}})
    expected_dtype = eltype(chains[1][feat_name])
    if occursin("_all_seq", feat_name)
        arrays = [get(c, feat_name, Array{expected_dtype}(undef, 0, 0)) for c in chains]
        return vcat([a for a in arrays if !isempty(a)]...; dims=2)
    else
        padded_feats = _pad_features_to_max(feat_name, chains, 1)
        return vcat(padded_feats...; dims=2)
    end
end

function merge_paired_and_unpaired_msa(example::Dict{String,Array})
    new_example = copy(example)
    for feature_name in vcat(NUM_SEQ_NUM_RES_MSA_FEATURES, NUM_SEQ_MSA_FEATURES)
        if haskey(example, feature_name) && haskey(example, feature_name * "_all_seq")
            feat = example[feature_name]
            feat_all_seq = example[feature_name * "_all_seq"]
            merged_feat = vcat(feat_all_seq, feat; dims=1)
            new_example[feature_name] = merged_feat
        end
    end
    new_example["num_alignments"] = Int32(size(new_example["msa"], 1))
    return new_example
end

const Mmcif = Any

@memoize function int_id_to_str_id(num::Int)
    if num <= 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Only positive integers allowed, got $num."))
    end
    num = num - 1
    output = Char[]
    while num >= 0
        push!(output, Char(num % 26 + Int('A')))
        num = div(num, 26) - 1
    end
    return String(output)
end

@memoize function str_id_to_int_id(str_id::String)
    if !occursin(r"^[A-Z]+$", str_id)
        throw(ArgumentError("String ID must be upper case letters, got $str_id."))
    end
    offset = Int('A') - 1
    output = 0
    for (i, c) in enumerate(str_id)
        output += (Int(c) - offset) * Int(26^(i-1))
    end
    return output
end

function get_resolution(mmcif::Any)

    end
    return nothing
end

function parse_oper_expr(oper_expression::String)
    function range_expander(m)
        start_val = parse(Int, m.captures[1])
        end_val = parse(Int, m.captures[2])
        return join(string.(start_val:end_val), ",")
    end
    ranges_expanded = replace(oper_expression, r"\b(\d+)-(\d+)" => range_expander)
    if occursin(r"^(\w+,)*\w+$", ranges_expanded)
        return [tuple(t) for t in split(ranges_expanded, ",")]
    elseif occursin(r"^\((\w+,)*\w+\)$", ranges_expanded)
        return [tuple(t) for t in split(ranges_expanded[2:end-1], ",")]
    elseif occursin(r"^\((\w+,)*\w+\)\((\w+,)*\w+\)$", ranges_expanded)
        parts = split(ranges_expanded[2:end-1], ")(")
        part1 = split(parts[1], ",")
        part2 = split(parts[2], ",")
        result = Tuple{String,String}[]
        for p1 in part1, p2 in part2
            push!(result, (p1, p2))
        end
        return result
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Unsupported oper_expression format: $oper_expression"))
    end
end

function format_float_array(values::Array{<:Real}, num_decimal_places::Int)
    if ndims(values) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("The given array must be 1D, got $(ndims(values))D"))
    end
    fmt = "%.$(num_decimal_places)f"
    return [Printf.format(Printf.Format(fmt), Float32(v)) for v in values]
end

const _PROTEIN_TO_ID = Dict(
    'A' => 0, 'B' => 3, 'C' => 4, 'D' => 3, 'E' => 6, 'F' => 13,
    'G' => 7, 'H' => 8, 'I' => 9, 'J' => 20, 'K' => 11, 'L' => 10,
    'M' => 12, 'N' => 2, 'O' => 20, 'P' => 14, 'Q' => 5, 'R' => 1,
    'S' => 15, 'T' => 16, 'U' => 4, 'V' => 19, 'W' => 17, 'X' => 20,
    'Y' => 18, 'Z' => 6, '-' => 21
)

const _RNA_TO_ID = merge(
    Dict(Char(i) => 30 for i in Int('A'):Int('Z')),
    Dict('-' => 21, 'A' => 22, 'G' => 23, 'C' => 24, 'U' => 25)
)

const _DNA_TO_ID = merge(
    Dict(Char(i) => 30 for i in Int('A'):Int('Z')),
    Dict('-' => 21, 'A' => 26, 'G' => 27, 'C' => 28, 'T' => 29)
)

const RNA_CHAIN = "polyribonucleotide"
const DNA_CHAIN = "polydeoxyribonucleotide"
const PROTEIN_CHAIN = "polypeptide(L)"

function extract_msa_features(msa_sequences::Vector{String}, chain_poly_type::String)
    if chain_poly_type == RNA_CHAIN
        char_map = _RNA_TO_ID
    elseif chain_poly_type == DNA_CHAIN
        char_map = _DNA_TO_ID
    elseif chain_poly_type == PROTEIN_CHAIN
        char_map = _PROTEIN_TO_ID
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("chain_poly_type=$chain_poly_type invalid."))
    end
    
    if isempty(msa_sequences)
        empty_msa = zeros(Int32, 0, 0)
        empty_deletions = zeros(Int32, 0, 0)
        return (empty_msa, empty_deletions)
    end
    
    num_rows = length(msa_sequences)
    num_cols = sum(1 for c in msa_sequences[1] if haskey(char_map, c))
    
    msa_arr = zeros(Int32, num_rows, num_cols)
    deletions_arr = zeros(Int32, num_rows, num_cols)
    
    for (problem_row, msa_sequence) in enumerate(msa_sequences)
        deletion_count = 0
        upper_count = 0
        problem_col = 0
        problems = String[]
        
        for current in msa_sequence
            msa_id = get(char_map, current, -1)
            if msa_id == -1
                if !islowercase(current)
                    push!(problems, "($problem_row, $problem_col):$current")
                end
                deletion_count += 1
            else
                if upper_count < size(deletions_arr, 2)
                    deletions_arr[problem_row, upper_count + 1] = deletion_count
                    msa_arr[problem_row, upper_count + 1] = msa_id
                    deletion_count = 0
                    upper_count += 1
                end
            end
            problem_col += 1
        end
        
        if !isempty(problems)
            throw(ArgumentError("Unknown residues in MSA: $(join(problems, ", ")). target_sequence: $(msa_sequences[1])"))
        end
        
        if upper_count != num_cols
            throw(ArgumentError("Invalid shape all strings must have the same number of non-lowercase characters; First string has $num_cols non-lowercase characters but '$msa_sequence' has $upper_count. target_sequence: $(msa_sequences[1])"))
        end
    end
    
    return (msa_arr, deletions_arr)
end

const _UNIPROT_ENTRY_NAME_REGEX = r"(?:tr|sp)\|(?:[A-Z0-9]{6,10})(?:_\d+)?\|(?:[A-Z0-9]{1,10}_)(?P<SpeciesId>[A-Z0-9]{1,5})"

function extract_species_ids(msa_descriptions::Vector{String})
    species_ids = String[]
    for msa_description in msa_descriptions
        msa_description = strip(msa_description)
        m = match(r"(?:tr|sp)\|(?:[A-Z0-9]{6,10})(?:_\d+)?\|(?:[A-Z0-9]{1,10}_)([A-Z0-9]{1,5})", msa_description)
        if m !== nothing
            push!(species_ids, m.captures[1])
        else
            push!(species_ids, "")
        end
    end
    return species_ids
end

using Memoization

struct Config
    block_m::Int
    block_n::Int
    block_k::Int
    num_warps::Int
    num_stages::Int
end

function next_power_of_2(n::Int)
    return 2^ceil(Int, log2(n))
end

function cdiv(a::Int, b::Int)
    return div(a + b - 1, b)
end

@memoize function _get_best_block_size(m::Int, n::Int, k::Int, core_count::Int)
    min_block_dim = 32
    block_m = min(max(min_block_dim, next_power_of_2(m)), 128)
    block_n = min(max(min_block_dim, next_power_of_2(n)), 256)
    block_n = min(block_n, div(128 * 128, block_m))
    block_k = 32
    split_k = 1
    num_blocks = cdiv(m, block_m) * cdiv(n, block_n)
    
    while num_blocks < core_count
        if block_m > min_block_dim
            block_m = div(block_m, 2)
            num_blocks = cdiv(m, block_m) * cdiv(n, block_n)
        elseif split_k * block_k < next_power_of_2(k)
            split_k *= 2
            num_blocks *= 2
        else
            break
        end
    end
    
    return (block_m, block_n, block_k)
end

function _abstractify(x)
    return x
end

function get_config(x::Any, w::Any, core_count::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing)
    if core_count === nothing
        core_count = 1
    end
    
    x = _abstractify(x)
    w = _abstractify(w)
    
    m = prod(size(x)[1:end-1])
    k = size(x)[end]
    n = size(w, 2)
    
    if n >= m
        block_m, block_n, block_k = _get_best_block_size(m, n, k, core_count)
    else
        block_n, block_m, block_k = _get_best_block_size(n, m, k, core_count)
    end
    
    return Config(
        block_m=block_m,
        block_n=div(block_n, 2),
        block_k=block_k,
        num_warps=4,
        num_stages=4
    )
end

    cif["_atom_type.symbol"] = sort(unique(old_cif["_atom_site.type_symbol"]))
    
    return merge(old_cif, cif)

struct Identifiers
    species_id::String
    Identifiers(species_id::String="") = new(species_id)
end

const _UNIPROT_PATTERN = r"""
(?:tr|sp)
\|
(?P<AccessionIdentifier>[A-Za-z0-9]{6,10})
(?:_\d)?
\|
(?:[A-Za-z0-9]+)
_
(?P<SpeciesIdentifier>([A-Za-z0-9]){1,5})
(?:_\d+)?
"""x

function _parse_sequence_identifier(msa_sequence_identifier::String)
    m = match(_UNIPROT_PATTERN, strip(msa_sequence_identifier))
    if m !== nothing
        return Identifiers(species_id=m[:SpeciesIdentifier])
    end
    return Identifiers()
end

function _extract_sequence_identifier(description::String)
    split_description = split(description)
    if !isempty(split_description)
        return split(split_description[1], '/')[1]
    else
        return nothing
    end
end

function get_identifiers(description::String)
    sequence_identifier = _extract_sequence_identifier(description)
    if sequence_identifier === nothing
        return Identifiers()
    else
        return _parse_sequence_identifier(sequence_identifier)
    end
end

using Statistics

function _get_group_cache_usage(group_size_m, num_blocks_m, num_blocks_n, block_m_bytes, block_n_bytes)
    num_live_progs = 1
    num_live_blocks_n = min(div(num_live_progs + group_size_m - 1, group_size_m), num_blocks_n)
    num_live_groups = div(num_live_progs + group_size_m * num_live_blocks_n - 1, group_size_m * num_live_blocks_n)
    num_live_blocks_m = min(num_live_groups * group_size_m, num_blocks_m)
    return num_live_blocks_m * block_m_bytes + num_live_blocks_n * block_n_bytes
end

function _get_pids(pid, num_blocks_m, num_blocks_n, group_size_m)
    if group_size_m == 1
        return (div(pid, num_blocks_n), mod(pid, num_blocks_n))
    end
    num_progs_in_group = group_size_m * num_blocks_n
    group_start_m = div(pid, num_progs_in_group) * group_size_m
    group_size_m = min(num_blocks_m - group_start_m, group_size_m)
    pid_m = group_start_m + mod(pid, group_size_m)
    pid_n = div(mod(pid, num_progs_in_group), group_size_m)
    return (pid_m, pid_n)
end

function _get_best_pids(pid; m, n, block_m, block_n, a_dtype_bytes, b_dtype_bytes)
    num_blocks_m = div(m + block_m - 1, block_m)
    num_blocks_n = div(n + block_n - 1, block_n)
    block_m_bytes = block_m * a_dtype_bytes
    block_n_bytes = block_n * b_dtype_bytes
    num_live_progs = 1
    
    group_size_m_usage(group_size_m) = _get_group_cache_usage(group_size_m, num_blocks_m, num_blocks_n, block_m_bytes, block_n_bytes)
    group_size_m = argmin([group_size_m_usage(gs) for gs in 1:min(num_live_progs, num_blocks_m)])
    
    group_size_n_usage(group_size_n) = _get_group_cache_usage(group_size_n, num_blocks_n, num_blocks_m, block_n_bytes, block_m_bytes)
    group_size_n = argmin([group_size_n_usage(gs) for gs in 1:min(num_live_progs, num_blocks_n)])
    
    if group_size_m_usage(group_size_m) <= group_size_n_usage(group_size_n)
        pid_m, pid_n = _get_pids(pid, num_blocks_m, num_blocks_n, group_size_m)
    else
        pid_n, pid_m = _get_pids(pid, num_blocks_n, num_blocks_m, group_size_n)
    end
    return (pid_m, pid_n)
end

function _apply_epilogue(epilogue::Function, x, args)
    return epilogue(x, args, 0, 0)
end

function _gated_linear_unit_kernel(x_ref, w_ref, v_ref, _, epilogue_in_refs, out_ref; block_m, block_n, block_k, activation, precision, epilogue)
    m = size(x_ref, 1)
    n = size(w_ref, 2)
    pid_m, pid_n = _get_best_pids(0, m=m, n=n, block_m=block_m, block_n=block_n, a_dtype_bytes=sizeof(eltype(x_ref)), b_dtype_bytes=sizeof(eltype(w_ref)) * 2)
    
    acc0 = zeros(Float32, block_m, block_n)
    acc1 = zeros(Float32, block_m, block_n)
    
    num_iters = div(size(x_ref, 2) + block_k - 1, block_k)
    
    for i in 0:num_iters-1
        x_block = zeros(eltype(x_ref), block_m, block_k)
        w_block = zeros(eltype(w_ref), block_k, block_n)
        v_block = zeros(eltype(v_ref), block_k, block_n)
        
        acc0 .+= x_block * w_block
        acc1 .+= x_block * v_block
    end
    
    proj = convert.(Float32, acc0)
    gates = convert.(Float32, acc1)
    
    out = proj .* (activation === nothing ? gates : activation.(gates))
    
    if epilogue !== nothing
        out = epilogue(out, epilogue_in_refs, pid_m, pid_n)
    end
end

function _gated_linear_unit(x, weights_projection, weights_gate; dst=nothing, activation=nothing, epilogue=nothing, epilogue_args=nothing, precision=nothing)
    if epilogue === nothing && epilogue_args !== nothing
        throw(ArgumentError("`epilogue_args` is specified but `epilogue` is Nothing."))
    end
    
    m = size(x, 1)
    n = size(weights_projection, 2)
    
    if dst === nothing
        return zeros(eltype(x), m, n)
    else
        return dst
    end
end

function gated_linear_unit(x, weights_projection, weights_gate; activation=nothing, precision=nothing)
    supported_dtypes = Set(["Float16", "Float32"])
    if !(string(eltype(x)) in supported_dtypes)
        throw(ArgumentError("Triton kernel does not support input datatype $(eltype(x)). Must be one of $supported_dtypes."))
    end
    
    batch_dims = size(x)[1:end-2]
    m = size(x, length(size(x))-1)
    n = size(weights_projection, 2)
    
    x_reshaped = reshape(x, prod(batch_dims), size(x)[end-1:end]...)
    
    result = _gated_linear_unit(x_reshaped, weights_projection, weights_gate, dst=nothing, activation=activation, precision=precision, epilogue=nothing, epilogue_args=nothing)
    
    return reshape(result, batch_dims..., m, n)
end

const DNA_CHAIN = "polydeoxyribonucleotide"
const DNA_RNA_HYBRID_CHAIN = "polydeoxyribonucleotide/polyribonucleotide hybrid"
const OTHER_CHAIN = "other"
const PEPTIDE_NUCLEIC_ACID_CHAIN = "peptide nucleic acid"
const POLYPEPTIDE_D_CHAIN = "polypeptide(D)"
const PROTEIN_CHAIN = "polypeptide(L)"
const RNA_CHAIN = "polyribonucleotide"

const STANDARD_POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES = Set([PROTEIN_CHAIN, DNA_CHAIN, RNA_CHAIN])
const LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES = Set([BRANCHED_CHAIN, MACROLIDE_CHAIN, NON_POLYMER_CHAIN])
const NON_POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES = union(LIGAND_CHAIN_TYPES, Set([WATER]))
const PEPTIDE_CHAIN_TYPES = Set([CYCLIC_PSEUDO_PEPTIDE_CHAIN, POLYPEPTIDE_D_CHAIN, PROTEIN_CHAIN, PEPTIDE_NUCLEIC_ACID_CHAIN])
const NUCLEIC_ACID_CHAIN_TYPES = Set([RNA_CHAIN, DNA_CHAIN, DNA_RNA_HYBRID_CHAIN])
const POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES = union(NUCLEIC_ACID_CHAIN_TYPES, PEPTIDE_CHAIN_TYPES, Set([OTHER_CHAIN]))

const TERMINAL_OXYGENS = Dict(PROTEIN_CHAIN => "OXT", DNA_CHAIN => "OP3", RNA_CHAIN => "OP3")
const RESIDUE_REPRESENTATIVE_ATOMS = Dict(PROTEIN_CHAIN => "CA", DNA_CHAIN => "C1'", RNA_CHAIN => "C1'")
const CRYSTALLIZATION_METHODS = Set(["X-RAY DIFFRACTION", "NEUTRON DIFFRACTION", "ELECTRON CRYSTALLOGRAPHY", "POWDER CRYSTALLOGRAPHY", "FIBER DIFFRACTION"])

const COVALENT_BOND = "covale"
const HYDROGEN_BOND = "hydrog"
const METAL_COORDINATION = "metalc"
const DISULFIDE_BRIDGE = "disulf"

function is_standard_polymer_type(chain_type::String)
    return chain_type in STANDARD_POLYMER_CHAIN_TYPES
end

function guess_polymer_type(chain_residues::Vector{String})
    residue_types = Dict{String,String}()
    
    counts = Dict(PROTEIN_CHAIN => 0, RNA_CHAIN => 0, DNA_CHAIN => 0, OTHER_CHAIN => 0)
    
    for residue in chain_residues
        residue_type = get(residue_types, residue, OTHER_CHAIN)
        if residue_type == PROTEIN_CHAIN
            return residue_type
        end
        counts[residue_type] += 1
    end
    
    tie_braker = Dict(PROTEIN_CHAIN => 3, RNA_CHAIN => 2, DNA_CHAIN => 1, OTHER_CHAIN => 0)
    
    order_fn(item) = (item[2], tie_braker[item[1]])
    
    most_probable_type = maximum(collect(counts), by=order_fn)[1]
    return most_probable_type
end

function fix_non_standard_polymer_res(; res_name::String, chain_type::String)
    one_letter_code = "X"
    
    if chain_type in PEPTIDE_CHAIN_TYPES || chain_type == OTHER_CHAIN
        return "UNK"
    elseif chain_type == RNA_CHAIN
        return "N"
    elseif chain_type == DNA_CHAIN
        return "N"
    elseif chain_type == DNA_RNA_HYBRID_CHAIN
        return "N"
    else
        throw(ArgumentError("Expected a protein/DNA/RNA chain but got $chain_type"))
    end
end
